results.title: Vexev Raises $6M to Scale Autonomous Robotic Vascular Ultrasound￼
results.description: What You Should Know Australian medical robotics and computational imaging startup Vexev raised $6M in new funding, bringing its total capital raised to date to $19M. The capital will support FDA 510(k) regulatory clearance, domestic manufacturing scale-up, and commercial launch in the United States for VxWave, its autonomous robotic tomographic ultrasound platform. results.title: Districts producing the most rice in Bangladesh in FY25
results.description: Bangladesh's rice production totalled 40.6 million tonnes in FY25, down 0.17% from 40.7 million tonnes a year earlier. Rangpur Division led rice production with a 19% share, followed by Rajshahi at 17%, while Barishal accounted for the smallest share at 7%. Source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS)
